settings.show_logs_tab_hint: Adds a Logs tab with recent backend activity — useful for debugging a failed download
settings.max_concurrent_hint: How many downloads run at the same time ({{min}}–{{max}}). More is not always faster — sources rate-limit too.
settings.rate_limit_hint: 0 means unlimited. The limit applies per download, not to the app total — with {{concurrency}} running at once the combined speed can reach {{concurrency}}× this number.
settings.background_hint: Closing the window minimises to the system tray and downloads keep going.

logs.description: Recent backend activity — job failures, retries, and fallback decisions. Useful for figuring out why a download didn't behave as expected.

errors.UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM: This link is not from a supported platform.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_ALL_ENGINES: No download engine could read this link. It may not be a media page, or the site may have changed.
errors.ACCESS_DENIED: This content is private, requires login, or is DRM-protected, so it can't be downloaded.
errors.INVALID_QUALITY_OPTION: The selected quality is no longer available for this link. Please preview it again.
errors.PREVIEW_REQUIRED: Please preview the link before downloading.
errors.DOWNLOAD_FAILED: The download failed. Please try again or use a different link.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Network problem. Check your connection — the download will retry automatically.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This item could not be found.
errors.INVALID_JOB_STATE: This action isn't available for the current download state.
errors.MISSING_QUALITY: Please choose a quality before downloading.
errors.FILE_UNREADABLE: That file could not be read.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: That file is too large — a URL list must be under 5 MB.
errors.FILE_NOT_TEXT: That file isn't readable text, so it can't hold a URL list.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong. Please try again.

compliance.title: Before you start downloading
compliance.body: Only download content you own or have permission to use. You are responsible for complying with copyright law and each platform's Terms of Service. This app does not support bypassing DRM or accessing private/paid content.
